Exampla Holdings plc and Jordan Placeholder

Release No.
LR-99901
June 10, 2025
June 9, 2025
Respondents
Exampla Holdings plc
Jordan Placeholder
Exampla Holdings plc CIK 0009999101

The Securities and Exchange Commission today announced that it filed settled charges against Exampla Holdings plc and its former finance director Jordan Placeholder in the United States District Court for the Southern District of New York, Civil Action No. 1:25-cv-09901 (S.D.N.Y.).

The SEC's complaint alleges that Exampla Holdings plc overstated segment revenue in periodic reports filed in 2023 and 2024. The complaint charges Exampla Holdings plc with violating Section 17(a) of the Securities Act of 1933, Section 10(b) of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934 and Rule 10b-5 thereunder, and Section 13(a) of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934.

Without admitting or denying the allegations in the complaint, Exampla Holdings plc consented to the entry of a final judgment that permanently enjoins it from violating the charged provisions and orders it to pay a civil penalty of $2,500,000. Mr. Placeholder consented to a judgment ordering him to pay a civil penalty of $75,000.

The Commission acknowledges the assistance of the European Commission, which reviewed a related transaction in case M.99001.

Northwind Securities LLC

Release No.
34-99902
File No.
3-99902
August 4, 2025
Respondents
Northwind Securities LLC
Northwind Securities LLC CIK 0009999202

The Commission instituted settled cease-and-desist proceedings against Northwind Securities LLC for violations of Section 15(c)(3) of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934 and Rule 15c3-3 thereunder.

Northwind Securities LLC consented to the order without admitting or denying the findings. The order imposes a cease-and-desist order and a censure.
